output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation will cause integer overflow and become stuck.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' operation will cause integer overflow.
The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation will cause integer overflow.

The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. Both 'newSellPrice' and 'newBuyPrice' are defined without max value constraint, attackers can set these large values to trigger overflow.
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'msg.value' is large, 'amount = msg.value / buyPrice' can cause overflow.
